title: OMEGA UNIVERSAL KEYLESS
features:
🔹 Key Features Explained
Aimbot – Smoothly locks onto the nearest enemy’s head. Works with F key even when the main GUI is minimized.

ESP (Highlight/Box/Name/Tracer) – See enemies through walls with full‑color indicators.

Hitbox Expander – Increase enemy hitbox size for easier hits; adjustable transparency and size.

Reach – Expand your own character’s hitbox (all body parts scale) – useful for melee games.

Show Hitbox – Toggle a green, transparent BoxHandleAdornment around your root part to visualize your own hitbox.

Fling Player – Enter a player’s name and click “FLING”; your character teleports inside them and applies massive BodyThrust force, launching them. Press “STOP” to cancel.

Auto Obby – Automatically navigates obstacle courses by detecting nearby platforms, moving toward them, and jumping when needed.

Follow Player – Select a target from a popup GUI; your character automatically follows them (teleports behind them).

Player Teleport & View – Open a list of all server players; click to teleport directly to them or to spectate them.

Server Hop & Rejoin – Quickly switch to another server or rejoin the current one.

Auto Clicker / Chat Spam – Automated clicking and message spamming with adjustable CPS/delay.

Click‑TP – Teleport to the exact spot you click on the ground (toggle on/off).

Freecam – Detach camera and fly around with WASD+Q/E (Shift for speed).

🔹 Keybinds & Auto‑Save
Every toggle (Aimbot, Fly, Noclip, etc.) can be assigned a custom keyboard key.

Click the ⌨️ KEYBINDS tab, click any feature, press the desired key → the binding is saved immediately.

Bindings persist between script runs (saved in getgenv() and optionally to a file using writefile if supported).
